title: SkillFrontmatter
description: JSON Schema for SKILL.md YAML frontmatter

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for the skill

description.description: Human-readable description of what the skill does and when to use it

trigger.description: Natural-language phrase or slash-command that activates the skill

disable-model-invocation.description: Claude-specific: when true, the agent must not invoke the model for this skill

user-invocable.description: Claude-specific: whether end-users can invoke this skill directly
